answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the delta graph. Re-attestations are stored in ledge and glacier lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1142 identities would post 1957 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
